author: Mohammad Z. Islam

steps.title: Prepare protein and crosslinker solutions
steps.instruction: Take 100 µl to 1 ml of purified gp37 LTF needle trimers in phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS). Dissolve NHS‑ester diazirine crosslinking reagent (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Rockford, IL) in DMSO to make a 10 mM stock solution immediately before use.

steps.title: Add diazirine crosslinker to protein
steps.instruction: Add the diazirine crosslinker solution to the trimers to reach a final crosslinker concentration of 0.5–2 mM. Use a 10‑fold molar excess of crosslinker if the protein concentration is >5 mg/ml; use a 20‑ to 50‑fold excess if the protein concentration is <5 mg/ml.

steps.title: Incubate labeling reaction on ice
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction on ice for 2 hours.

steps.title: Quench labeling reaction
steps.instruction: Add Quenching Buffer to achieve a final concentration of 100 mM Tris‑HCl, pH 8.0, then incubate on ice for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Form gp37‑LPS complex
steps.instruction: Combine 150 µg diazirine‑labeled gp37 LTF needle trimers with 500 µg E. coli O111:B4 LPS (Sigma‑Aldrich, St Louis, MO) in PBS to a total volume of 200 µl and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour. For controls, incubate the same amounts of diazirine‑labeled gp37 without LPS and LPS without diazirine‑labeled gp37 in the same buffer in separate tubes.

steps.title: UV‑crosslink reaction mixtures
steps.instruction: Keep the reaction tubes on an ice pack and irradiate with a Stratagene Stratalinker 2400 for 15 minutes to prevent excessive heat generation.

steps.title: Purify crosslinked products by SEC
steps.instruction: Separate the crosslinked products by size‑exclusion chromatography using a Superose 6 10/300 GL column (GE Healthcare Bioscience).

steps.title: Analyze fractions by SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Analyze the collected fractions by SDS‑PAGE and stain the gel with Silver Stain (Pierce, Rockford, IL).
